i-json-lone-surrogate.rule: Data MUST be valid I-JSON: no unpaired surrogate in a string

type-missing-on-card.rule: The topmost object MUST have the @type property set

type-mismatch.rule: @type MUST match the type name of the object it is set on

type-timestamp-missing.rule: A Timestamp in Anniversary.date MUST have its @type set

id-empty.rule: An Id MUST be at least 1 octet long

id-too-long.rule: An Id MUST be at most 255 octets long

id-bad-character.rule: An Id MUST only contain A-Za-z0-9, hyphen and underscore

unsigned-int-string.rule: An UnsignedInt is a JSON Number

patch-array-index-null.rule: A patch ending in an array index MUST NOT have a null value

patch-array-append.rule: A pointer MUST NOT use "-" as an array index

patch-parent-missing.rule: All reference tokens before the last MUST already exist

patch-array-index-missing.rule: A final array index MUST already exist in the array

patch-prefix-conflict.rule: No pointer of a PatchObject may be the prefix of another one

patch-value-invalid.rule: A patch value MUST be valid for the property being set

patch-null-on-mandatory.rule: A null patch value is only valid for an optional property

utc-date-time-zero-fraction.rule: Fractional seconds MUST NOT be included unless non-zero

utc-date-time-trailing-zero.rule: Fractional seconds MUST NOT have trailing zeros

utc-date-time-date-only.rule: A UTCDateTime is in RFC 3339 "date-time" format

utc-date-time-impossible.rule: A UTCDateTime is a valid RFC 3339 date-time

utc-date-time-hour-out-of-range.rule: A UTCDateTime is in RFC 3339 "date-time" format

common-property-not-allowed.rule: A common property MUST only be set where explicitly allowed

context-unknown.rule: contexts keys are enumerated: private, work

context-false.rule: A context set to false: the RFC demands true for an Address only

pref-zero.rule: pref MUST be in the range 1 to 100

pref-above-100.rule: pref MUST be in the range 1 to 100

phonetic-script-invalid.rule: phoneticScript MUST be a valid RFC 5646 script subtag

phonetic-system-unknown.rule: phoneticSystem values are enumerated: ipa, jyut, piny

property-wrong-type.rule: A property value MUST adhere to the data type of the property

property-null.rule: A property value MUST adhere to the data type: null is no value

type-case-variant.rule: A type name differing only in case from a known one is invalid

property-case-variant.rule: A property name differing only in case from a known one is invalid

property-case-variant-nested.rule: A property name differing only in case is invalid in any object

enum-case-variant.rule: An enumerated value differing only in case from a known one is invalid

property-name-not-camel-case.rule: Registered property names are notated in lower camel case

reserved-id.rule: "id" is reserved in a Card (RFC 9610, JMAP for Contacts)

reserved-extra.rule: An object with the reserved property "extra" is invalid

reserved-extra-nested.rule: "extra" is reserved in every JSContact object

property-name-invalid.rule: A name neither of registered syntax nor a v-extension is no property

enum-unknown-value.rule: An enumerated value MUST be IANA-registered or vendor-specific

vendor-property-name-solidus.rule: A vendor property name MUST NOT contain the SOLIDUS

vendor-property-name-tilde.rule: A vendor property name MUST NOT contain the TILDE

vendor-property-prefix-invalid.rule: The vendor prefix MUST follow the v-prefix ABNF

vendor-property-name-empty.rule: The name after the vendor prefix MUST NOT be empty

vendor-property-name-quotation-mark.rule: A vendor property name MUST NOT contain the QUOTATION MARK

vendor-value-invalid.rule: A vendor-specific value MUST be a valid v-extension

version-unregistered.rule: version MUST be an IANA-registered JSContact version

language-not-a-language-tag.rule: language is an RFC 5646 language tag

members-value-false.rule: Each value of members MUST be true

members-in-non-group.rule: If members is set, kind MUST be "group"

members-without-kind.rule: If members is set, kind MUST be "group": the default is "individual"

prod-id-empty.rule: prodId MUST be at least one character long

relation-value-false.rule: Each value of Relation.relation MUST be true

uid-missing-in-1.0.rule: uid is mandatory in a Card of version "1.0" (RFC 9982 section 4)

name-neither-components-nor-full.rule: components MUST be set if full is not set

name-components-empty.rule: components MUST have at least one entry that is not a separator

name-components-only-separators.rule: components MUST have at least one entry that is not a separator

name-unordered-with-separator.rule: If isOrdered is false, components MUST NOT contain a separator

name-default-separator-unordered.rule: defaultSeparator MUST NOT be set if isOrdered is false

name-default-separator-without-component.rule: defaultSeparator MUST NOT be set if components is not set

name-sort-as-without-components.rule: sortAs MUST NOT be set if components is not set

name-sort-as-key-not-a-kind.rule: Each sortAs key MUST be a valid name component kind

name-sort-as-kind-not-in-components.rule: For each sortAs key a component of that kind MUST exist

name-consecutive-separators.rule: Two consecutive separator components MUST NOT be inserted

name-phonetic-without-system-or-script.rule: With phonetic set, Name phoneticSystem or phoneticScript MUST be set

organization-neither-name-nor-units.rule: At least one of Organization name and units MUST be set

organization-units-empty.rule: units, if set, MUST contain at least one entry

speak-to-as-empty.rule: At least one of grammaticalGender and pronouns MUST be set

title-kind-unknown.rule: Title.kind values are enumerated: title, role

email-address-not-addr-spec.rule: address MUST be an RFC 5322 addr-spec

online-service-neither-uri-nor-user.rule: At least uri or user MUST be set

phone-feature-false.rule: Each value of features MUST be true

language-pref-not-a-language-tag.rule: language MUST be an RFC 5646 language tag

calendar-kind-unknown.rule: Calendar.kind values are enumerated: calendar, freeBusy

context-of-address-elsewhere.rule: billing and delivery are contexts of an Address only

address-empty.rule: One of components, coordinates, countryCode, full, timeZone MUST be set

address-components-only-separators.rule: components MUST have at least one entry that is not a separator

address-unordered-with-separator.rule: If isOrdered is false, components MUST NOT contain a separator

address-default-separator-unordered.rule: defaultSeparator MUST NOT be set if isOrdered is false

address-default-separator-without-compon.rule: defaultSeparator MUST NOT be set if components is not set

address-time-zone-unknown.rule: timeZone MUST be a name of the IANA Time Zone Database

address-context-false.rule: Each value of Address.contexts MUST be true

address-country-code-not-alpha-2.rule: countryCode is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

address-components-empty.rule: components MUST have at least one entry that is not a separator

address-consecutive-separators.rule: Two consecutive separator components MUST NOT be inserted

address-phonetic-without-system-or-scrip.rule: With phonetic set, Address phoneticSystem or phoneticScript MUST be set

crypto-key-kind-not-vendor.rule: No kind is registered for a CryptoKey: only a vendor value fits

directory-kind-unknown.rule: Directory.kind values are enumerated: directory, entry

directory-list-as-zero.rule: listAs, if set, MUST be higher than zero

media-kind-unknown.rule: Media.kind values are enumerated: photo, sound, logo

patch-result-invalid.rule: The localized Card is invalid: a Name without components or full

patch-targets-localizations.rule: A patch MUST NOT target the localizations property

localizations-key-not-a-language-tag.rule: The keys of localizations are RFC 5646 language tags

anniversary-kind-unknown.rule: Anniversary.kind values are enumerated: birth, death, wedding

anniversary-date-not-an-object.rule: date is a PartialDate or a Timestamp object

partial-date-empty.rule: A PartialDate is a date, a year, a month in a year or a day in a month

partial-date-month-out-of-range.rule: month is an integer from 1 to 12

partial-date-month-alone.rule: If month is set, year or day MUST be set

partial-date-day-out-of-range.rule: day is an integer from 1 to 31

partial-date-day-invalid-in-month.rule: day depends on the validity within the month and year

partial-date-day-without-month.rule: If day is set, month MUST be set

partial-date-calendar-scale-unknown.rule: calendarScale MUST be a CLDR calendar name or a vendor value

partial-date-month-zero.rule: month is an integer from 1 to 12

partial-date-day-zero.rule: day is an integer from 1 to 31

keyword-value-false.rule: Each value of keywords MUST be true

author-empty.rule: At least one Author property other than @type MUST be set

n1.note: Open office hours are 1600 to 1715 EST, Mon-Fri

personal-info-kind-unknown.rule: PersonalInfo.kind values are enumerated: expertise, hobby, interest

personal-info-level-unknown.rule: PersonalInfo.level values are enumerated: high, medium, low

personal-info-list-as-zero.rule: listAs, if set, MUST be higher than zero

vcard-props-entry-too-short.rule: A JCardProp has a name, parameters, a type and at least one value

vcard-params-not-an-object.rule: vCardParams MUST be a JSON object

vcard-params-value-not-a-string.rule: Each vCardParams value is a String or a String[]

vcard-name-invalid.rule: vCardName MUST be valid according to the "name" ABNF of RFC 6350
